name: MARK-1-the-verdict-never-reaches-the-point
old: out.push({ id: e.peer.id, name: e.peer.name ?? '', vouched: e.peer.v === true, x: s.x, y: s.y,
new: out.push({ id: e.peer.id, name: e.peer.name ?? '', vouched: false, x: s.x, y: s.y,
note: ACC1d carries the relay's verdict all the way to the client and this is the last inch of it. Hard-wired false, the badge can never appear and the whole seam is decoration.

name: MARK-2-everybody-wears-one
note: A badge over every head is the same as a badge over none - it stops being a signal and becomes wallpaper. That is the exact failure Mac named in the first cut ("Why a question mark since even guests get a name?"), and flipping the polarity does not make the repo immune to it.

name: MARK-3-the-mark-is-prefixed-INTO-the-name
old:
const tint = colorOf?.(n.id) ?? [1, 1, 1, 1];
      drawText(renderer, font, n.name, Math.round(n.x - tw / 2), Math.round(top), s, tint);
new:
const tint = colorOf?.(n.id) ?? [1, 1, 1, 1];
      drawText(renderer, font, (n.vouched === true ? NAME_MARK : '') + n.name, Math.round(n.x - tw / 2), Math.round(top), s, tint);
note: `tw` was measured off the NAME, so a prefixed glyph shifts the whole label off the head it belongs to - and only the badged peers' labels move, which reads as the name drifting.

name: MARK-4-the-DOM-mark-is-written-into-the-tag
note: Writing the badge onto the WRAPPER takes the name element with it - textContent on a parent replaces its children - so the label is the badge and nothing else.

name: MARK-5-the-mark-takes-the-partys-colour
note: SOC4's green says who somebody is to you; the badge says whether the service issued the name. One pixel, two systems, and the colour belongs to the first.

name: MARK-6-a-glyph-the-classic-font-cannot-draw
note: The classic face draws through a Daggerfall bitmap font. A tick is the obvious badge and the font has no record for it, so `drawText` would draw NOTHING AT ALL in that face while the DOM face showed it - the two faces disagreeing about whether the player was ever told.

name: MARK-7-absent-read-as-vouched
note: THE RELAY'S WIRE HAS NO `v: false`. server/src/index.js sends `v: who.verified || undefined` and OMITS the field otherwise, so ABSENT IS THE UNVOUCHED SIGNAL. Read as `!== false`, every unchecked name is badged as checked - which is worse under this polarity than under the first cut, because the badge is the thing a player is asked to TRUST.

name: MARK-8-the-polarity-back-on-the-unvouched
note: Mac's own correction, held as a law rather than as a memory: the badge goes on the name the service ISSUED, not on the name it could not check. Flipped back, it accuses nearly every head while accounts are optional, and a relay whose key will not import accuses EVERYBODY at once instead of badging nobody.
